verdict.rationale: New Relic has an AI assistant (New Relic AI), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows New Relic publishing its own MCP server for outside AI tools to connect to. That is the server role and earns no credit here; nothing shows New Relic AI consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
